subject: business-studies
title: Portfolio Balance
welcome_lead: Why a balanced portfolio of products beats one big bet.
meta_desc: A-Level Portfolio: balance across the BCG quadrants.
final_note: Healthy firms keep cash cows feeding stars and pruning dogs.

concepts.def: Today's question marks become tomorrow's stars then cows.
Selling or closing a business unit.
Removing weak products to focus resources.
Value created when products share resources.
New products eating sales of existing ones.

walkthroughs.body_html: Successful products march from question mark through star to cash cow, sometimes ending as a dog. A firm with no question marks today has no stars tomorrow.
Dogs absorb management attention out of proportion to revenue. Divestment frees capital and focus. Some dogs deserve protection - loss leaders that draw traffic to better products.
Shared brands, channels and R&D create synergy. A portfolio of unrelated products often disappoints - conglomerate discounts on stock markets reflect this.
